edge.tagline: London-based creative director making complex ideas feel precise, human and inevitable.

items.label: Design Strategy
items.tooltip: Understanding the challenge, identifying worthwhile opportunities and helping a team decide where to focus.

items.label: Creative Direction
items.tooltip: Giving the work a clear point of view and guiding the people and decisions that shape it.

items.label: Product Design
items.tooltip: Connecting user needs with business priorities, then developing products that make sense for both.

items.label: Brand Identity
items.tooltip: Creating a recognisable identity and defining how it comes through in products, services and communications.

items.label: Creative Technology
items.tooltip: Exploring what code, AI and generative systems can offer, then building working prototypes to test their value.

items.label: Motion & 3D
items.tooltip: Using movement, space and timing to explain ideas and give digital experiences character.

philosophy.textBeforeLink: Innovation happens when different creative disciplines collide. By bringing together design, technology, and storytelling, I create experiences that feel both familiar and entirely new. Precise through constraint, expressive through humanity.
philosophy.mobileTextBeforeLink: Innovation happens when different creative disciplines collide. I bring together design, technology, and storytelling to create experiences that feel familiar yet entirely new.

contact.description: If you’re building a product, service or experience that needs design, technology and AI to move together, send me a note.
